publication.commitToCampaignBranch: GRANTED: commits on campaign/fresh-100 and on campaign fix branches (campaign/fix-<family>). Only campaign files, harness changes and focused fixes; no unrelated changes.
publication.pushBranches: GRANTED: push campaign/fresh-100 and campaign/fix-* branches to instashop-dev/deployz. No force-push, no push to main, no tag push.
publication.openPullRequests: GRANTED: create and update focused PRs against main, one root-cause family per fix PR. Campaign reports and redacted artifacts go through a PR from campaign/fresh-100.
publication.mergePullRequests: GRANTED only through policy.publication.mergeProcedure: all required checks SUCCESS on the current PR head and an Opus review of that head. No admin bypass, no merge with missing, pending or failed checks.
publication.publishTemplatesOrDeploy: GRANTED only as the automatic production run that a merge of an approved campaign PR triggers: CI on main -> "Deploy API" (CDK stack Deployz, api.deployz.dev; also republishes bootstrap templates because BOOTSTRAP_REPUBLISH=on) and/or "Deploy web" (Lightsail deployz-web, app.deployz.dev), each only when its path filter matches. After such a merge the coordinator watches those runs and records their result. NOT GRANTED: manual workflow_dispatch of deploy-api/deploy-web/aws-canary, local cdk deploy, local publish:bootstrap, changes to repository variables or secrets, and the production canary (--production).
publication.requiredChecks: Check runs of the CI workflow on the PR head commit, as named on recent PRs (#495, #496): "Plan tests", "Test and build", "Simulated E2E (fixture-1)", "Simulated E2E (fixture-2)", "Simulated E2E (fixture-3)", "Simulated E2E (scenarios)", "PR Gate".
publication.stagingEnvironment: None exists. The repository has no GitHub environments and no staging deploy workflow; deploy-api and deploy-web target production only. The AWS test account is only the customer-side account for Stage B and the version canary, and stays under gates.awsAuthorized.
publication.publishedContent: Never include credentials, .env values, evidence-dir ledgers, cached corpus source (.cache/) or raw logs in a commit, PR, comment or artifact. Run a secret/redaction grep on the staged diff before each push.
publication.authorizedBy: User, 2026-10-08, in the Code tab session (includes production deploys triggered by merging approved campaign fixes).
publication.notes: A task that needs an action outside these grants is BLOCKED, not done. If a merge-triggered production deploy fails, stop new merges, record the failure as a release blocker and leave recovery to the user unless a separate grant exists.
publication.mergeProcedure: Mandatory, because GitHub requires no checks on main (do not change rulesets). (1) gh pr view <n> --json headRefOid,statusCheckRollup,mergeable. (2) "Plan tests" and "PR Gate" must exist with conclusion SUCCESS on headRefOid. (3) Every other CI check run on headRefOid must be SUCCESS, or SKIPPED only when PR Gate passed (PR Gate fails a skip the plan needed). (4) Any missing, queued, in-progress, pending, failed, cancelled, timed-out, neutral or action-required check means NOT passing. (5) Opus reviews the full diff of headRefOid and writes campaign/results/<task id>/review.md naming that SHA. (6) Merge with gh api -X PUT repos/instashop-dev/deployz/pulls/<n>/merge -f sha=<headRefOid> so a newer push cannot be merged unreviewed. (7) Watch the CI-on-main and Deploy API/Deploy web runs it triggers and record their results.

policy.stateWrites: Only Opus edits campaign/state.json and campaign/tasks.json. Write <file>.tmp, validate JSON, then rename over the file.
